description: Visual Studio 2022 is open with the InventoryManager C# console application solution. Add a new C# class file named 'InventoryReport.cs' to the project. Right-click the project in Solution Explorer, select Add > Class..., name it 'InventoryReport.cs', and click Add. In the new file, add a public method 'GenerateSummary' that takes a List<InventoryItem> parameter and returns a string summary of the inventory (total items count and total value). Save the file with Ctrl+S.
